facts.fact: The SLEITI open data policy states that SLEITI publishes extractives data in EITI Reports and that mining payment and licence data is published and accessible through the Government of Sierra Leone's Online Repository, drawing on the Mining Cadastre Administration System; the document carries no printed date and is dated 2016.
facts.system: Government of Sierra Leone Online Repository

systems.system: Government of Sierra Leone Online Repository
systems.country_label: Government of Sierra Leone Online Repository (mining cadastre data); http://www.nma.gov.sl/resourcecontracts/ for contracts

note: Open licence, open data formats and the new Open Data Portal are stated as policy aims or plans, so no licensed fact.
